title: Diagnostics
lead: Runs again on every page load. Never shows passwords or tokens.
guildsTitle: Your servers (where you have manage permission)
guildsNote: Servers where the bot is active come first; the “Bot can see it” column is only queried for those (–). A server can be opened if all three say “yes”. If “Bot active” is no but “Bot can see it” is yes, the bot hasn’t written the server to the guild_registry table yet — restart the bot.
envFix: Set the missing variables / secrets (npx wrangler secret put …).
turnstileMissing: Not configured — login works without a captcha.
turnstileFix: Put TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY in wrangler.jsonc, TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY: npx wrangler secret put TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
userGuildsFix: 401: log out and back in. 429: wait a minute.
botTokenOk: The bot can access the data of at least one of your servers.
botTokenFail: None of the requests made as the bot succeeded.
botTokenFix: Check the DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN secret (npx wrangler secret put DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN).
botTokenAbsent: The bot isn’t on any of the servers you can manage.

fix.connections: The database user has hit its connection limit (the bot uses it too). Reduce Hyperdrive’s connections: npx wrangler hyperdrive update ID --origin-connection-limit 3 — or ask your host for a higher limit.
fix.access: Wrong username / password, or the user has no access to the database. Check the Hyperdrive configuration or the DATABASE_URL secret.
fix.noTable: The table doesn’t exist — (re)start the bot with the latest version (6.1); it creates the tables.
fix.tableAccess: The web DB user has no privileges on this table — run the GRANT statements from the README.
fix.unreachable: The database server can’t be reached. Remote (external) connections must be allowed at your host, and the host / port must be correct.
fix.other: Check the error message; if it isn’t clear, send it over.
